info.text:
The government's Intel stake lost over $11 billion on paper in one day.
Intel fell about 29% on Friday, Oct 30, its worst day since 1974, after guiding fourth-quarter sales to $15B-$16B vs about $17B expected.
The US took about 10% of Intel (433.3M shares at $20.47) in August 2025. By our math, Friday's drop cut that stake by about $11.4B on paper; it is still worth about $28.5B, over 3x its $8.9B cost.
Same day, the S&P 500 fell 1.8%.
Sources: CNBC, Yahoo Finance, AP (Oct 30, 2026); Intel Q3 2026 release (Oct 29, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
